title: [NSClient 3.0.0.2-Master] Problem using NSClient 3.0.0.2 from the latest Master version
symptom: When NSClient 3.0.0.2 is installed on another phone and the master profile is imported, the Nightscout page crashes and needs to be restarted. Even without importing the profile, after configuring the NS address, NSClient returns an error and the Nightscout page crashes.
cause: The issue is related to Calibrations processing, which is resolved in dev now.
fix: The fix is to update to the dev version where the Calibrations processing issue is resolved. The maintainer also advised not to import master data into NSClient, just configure it for NS address.
evidence_quote: I believe this is related to Calibrations processsing which is resolved in dev now
